杰克与校门口的计划(Jack and the the school gate P: 一篇关于校园生活的A2短文:杰克与汤姆的经历和小计划。
Both of them like soup and water. Jack thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Tom is interested in singing. Prices include tax already.

Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Tom's birthday is in December. The teachers' office is one of the best places in the city. In fact, the photographer took lovely pictures at our school sports day.
Jack hopes to visit London one day. Jack learned a lot about math. Jack usually has soup for breakfast. We laughed at his funny story.
There are always many people at the school gate. Jack drinks water after doing sports. It takes twenty minutes to get to the teachers' office by bike.
